docs: Curriculum content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of modules, each with a short label, a title, a line and a meta line (the length). One object is valid in every curriculum layout (rows, two columns of cards).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

modules.docs: the modules, in the order they are taken

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

description.docs: one line about the module; empty: none

meta.docs: the meta line (2 hours, 5 lessons); empty: none
